LADDER REFERENCE BUILT, LADDER NOT ARMED. Rolling 30d highs (Coinbase daily candles): BTC $82,283, ETH $2,567, SOL $110.65 -> rungs -12/-18/-25%: BTC 72,409 / 67,472 / 61,712; ETH 2,258.96 / 2,104.94 / 1,925.25; SOL 97.37 / 90.73 / 82.99. Stored in sleeve.ladder_reference. NOT ARMED for three reasons, in order of weight. (1) STRUCTURAL, and the operator must rule on it: charter law 1 / build item B16 require every resting buy rung to be hand-paired with a stop_limit at placement, and that is mechanically IMPOSSIBLE on Robinhood spot - a stop_limit SELL requires quantity you already hold, so a rung cannot be paired until a session wakes after it fills. Every unattended rung is therefore an unpaired rung; placing one tonight would break law 1 as written. (2) Arming input says no anyway: the macro driver is UNRESOLVED (US inflation print imminent, 9/16 FOMC hike risk) - the charter's own read law calls an ongoing macro driver FIRST-LEG, not terminal, and a rung that fills into it is exactly the knife the ledger says not to catch. (3) No capitulation conditioning: F&G 66 Greed, funding positive, short liqs dominant, BTC only -3.9% off its 30d high. Regime line ($59-61k June-2026 low) is clear at $79.0k - note the BTC -25% rung ($61,712) sits ON that line, so a fill there is simultaneously a scale-DOWN signal, which is a second argument against resting it unattended.

(2) NO MAJOR DOWN AT ALL, let alone -7%: BTC +0.71%, ETH +3.99%, SOL +3.33%, XRP +1.72%, DOGE +1.04% vs prior close. The -7% criterion cannot be near-missed on a green day and is not spun as one. (3) NO NEW HACK OR CONTAGION: the only live incident remains the Liquid Network federation drain (09-07), screened and PASSED 09-09, already in argus_ab.json as detected/not-graded; it does not re-fire and does not re-enter the sample. Conditioning: F&G 56 Greed, down 13 points from 69 - the sharpest one-day cooling since launch, but Greed is not fear and a falling sentiment print is a vol signal, which law 6 bans as a trigger. Funding near-neutral (OKX 8h BTC +0.00467% / ETH +0.00129% / SOL -0.00087%): no leverage stress to purge, which is exactly what a terminal-flush read would need and does not have.

SECOND STALE-HEADLINE KILL IN TWO SESSIONS. A story headlined 'Crypto hack worth $290m triggers DeFi contagion shock' ranked high in today's criterion-3 sweep. Verified before acting: it is the KelpDAO / LayerZero rsETH bridge exploit (~116,500 rsETH, ~$293M, a 1-of-1 DVN misconfiguration), dated APRIL 18-19 2026 - the Bloomberg URL carries 2026-04-19 in its path. FIVE MONTHS STALE, killed. The publisher page itself 403'd, so the date was confirmed from an independent search rather than assumed from the ranking. Yesterday's kill was a June cascade headline; today's is an April exploit. Two in two sessions is a pattern in the INPUT, not the market: search ranks crypto-disaster copy by engagement, not recency, and an eager watcher reading either as current manufactures a criterion-3 trigger out of a resolved event. The standing discipline - date-verify every headline before it counts - is earning its keep.

THE DAY'S REAL EVENT WAS A MACRO PRINT, AND MACRO PRINTS ARE BANNED GROUND (law 6). August CPI, 08:30 ET: headline +0.4% m/m / 3.4% y/y IN LINE, but CORE +0.3% m/m came in 0.1pp HOTTER than forecast (core y/y 2.4%, in line); gasoline +3.9% carried over a third of the monthly increase. Market odds of a Fed HIKE at the 09-16 FOMC moved above 65%. Crypto rallied INTO the hawkish print: ETH ran 2,433 -> 2,667 (+9.6%) across the 12:00-14:00Z window straddling the release, on 55,324 ETH in the 14:00Z hour and 234,109 on the day (~2x the prior session's 111,004), then faded to 2,544, -4.61% off the high. I am recording this and trading NOTHING on it. The read that matters for the ladder is second-order: a market that rallied 9.6% on a hawkish CPI is positioned LONG and UNHEDGED into an FOMC whose hike odds just crossed 65%. If a flush comes in the next five days it is a FIRST LEG into a live driver, which is precisely the knife the ledger says not to catch - and an unattended rung is exactly how you get filled by it.
